protected_causal_rule: A protected causal case requires exact material_error and causal_overclaim labels. Mechanism identification remains part of composite/core scoring but is not duplicated in this protected subgate when a supported mechanism is accompanied by an unsupported identity.
changes_from_v5: Fresh cases plus the prospectively clarified protected-causal subgate; no model, prompt, endpoint, threshold, schema, rubric, isolation, or retry change.
qualification_rule: Both passes independently satisfy every gate.
uncertainty_rule: Report pass-specific Wilson 95 percent intervals; zero observed errors never means zero population error.
retry_policy: Transport-only bounded retry; never retry a usable or inconvenient judgment.
activation_condition: Both fresh passes qualify and the result manifest is committed before any study scoring.
